displayName: [NOT DEPLOYABLE] NBD Pro — Claude daily token budget exceeded

documentation.content:
A user has exceeded their daily Anthropic token budget in claudeProxy. Normal for heavy power users; investigate if the same uid trips this repeatedly or multiple uids trip it at once (= possible credential stuffing).

---
NOT DEPLOYABLE (2026-09-13) — it cannot fire as intended. "Daily AI budget exceeded" exists only in the HTTP response body at functions/handlers/ai.js:201; nothing logs it, so the textPayload clause never matches. The other clause is the catch-all logger.error("claudeProxy error") at ai.js:292, under service_name="claudeProxy" — camelCase, which matches nothing (Cloud Run names are lowercase). Lowercasing it would alert on EVERY claudeProxy error, not on budgets. Real fix is code: log a distinct line (e.g. logger.warn("ai_budget_exceeded", {uid})) where the 429 is returned, deploy, then point conditionMatchedLog at it and set enabled true. Zero matches for any budget text in the 7 days before this note.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="claudeProxy" AND jsonPayload.message="claudeProxy error" OR textPayload:"Daily AI budget exceeded"
